programs.description: Vernon Griffith's 8-week TrainHeroic plan: 3 days a week of hip and knee mobility, single-leg strength, rotational and core work. Exercises run in lettered groups (A1/A2 …): go straight through a group, rest after it. Every exercise plays Griffith's own demo where he has one.
programs.goal: Build the hips, single-leg strength and durability.
